arguments.summary: Fixed LRUCache.get() in lru/cache.py so a cache hit counts as a use: on a hit it now re-inserts the key at the end of the internal dict (most-recent position) before returning the value, instead of just returning it. This makes the issue's scenario work — after put("a"), put("b"), get("a"), put("c")...
